```swift title="Swift"
import TreeSitterLanguagePack

let configObj = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.processConfigFromJson("{\"language\":\"javascript\"}")
let result = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.process(source: "import fs from 'fs';\nimport path from 'path';\n\nfunction process(input) {\n    return input.trim();\n}\n", config: configObj)
debugPrint(result.language())
```
